sections.title: W/NW TX INTO SRN OK THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: THE CLOSED MIDLEVEL LOW OVER THE CENTRAL ROCKIES IS IN THE PROCESS OF REFORMING OVER THE NRN PLAINS...WHILE A TRAILING SHORTWAVE TROUGH EJECTS ENEWD FROM THE SRN ROCKIES TO THE CENTRAL PLAINS. THE ASSOCIATED SYNOPTIC COLD FRONT IS MOVING SWD ACROSS THE TX PANHANDLE TO THE SOUTH PLAINS...AND THIS BOUNDARY EXTENDS NNEWD ACROSS NW OK AND CENTRAL KS TO SRN IA. OUTFLOW FROM OVERNIGHT CONVECTION HAS MOVED WELL S OF THE FRONT INTO CENTRAL/ERN OK AND CENTRAL MO...AND THIS OUTFLOW SHOULD PERSIST INTO THIS AFTERNOON AND CONTINUE TO DRIFT SWD INTO SRN OK. BY MID AFTERNOON...EXPECT ADDITIONAL SURFACE-BASED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE SLOW-MOVING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY AND FRONT ACROSS W/NW TX INTO SRN OK. THIS AREA WILL LIE ALONG THE SERN FRINGE OF THE STRONGER MID-UPPER LEVEL FLOW...WHERE DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR AND MLCAPE VALUES OF 2000-3000 J/KG WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR SUPERCELLS. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE MAIN SEVERE THREATS WITH THESE STORMS...THOUGH A COUPLE OF TORNADOES WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON WITH THE INITIAL DISCRETE STORMS ALONG THE SURFACE BOUNDARIES WHERE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR WILL BE SOMEWHAT STRONGER. STORM MERGERS WILL LIKELY LEAD TO UPSCALE GROWTH OF ONE OR

sections.title: IL/INDIANA/OH THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: THE REMNANTS OF AN OVERNIGHT THUNDERSTORM COMPLEX CONTINUE TO MOVE EWD OVER CENTRAL IL THIS MORNING...ALONG AN E-W QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT THAT EXTENDS EWD ACROSS NRN INDIANA/OH. EXPECT THE CONVECTION TO CONTINUE TO MOVE EWD ALONG THIS BOUNDARY THROUGH THE MORNING...MAINTAINED BY AN INFLUX OF LOWER 70 BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS. WEAKENING CONVECTIVE INHIBITION WITH DAYTIME HEATING WILL ALLOW ADDITIONAL THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARY AND IN THE OPEN WARM SECTOR...WITH CLUSTERS OF STORMS EXPECTED TO SPREAD EWD THROUGH THE AFTERNOON ACROSS INDIANA AND OH. THE PRESENCE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY AND DEEP-LAYER WLY SHEAR OF 30-40 KT /ENHANCED BY THE REMNANT MCV OVER W CENTRAL IL/ WILL SUPPORT BOTH ORGANIZED MULTICELL CLUSTERS AND SOME EMBEDDED BOW/SUPERCELL STRUCTURES. RELATIVELY WARM PROFILES/MODEST LAPSE RATES AND WEAK LOW-LEVEL SHEAR SUGGEST THAT DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE MAIN SEVERE THREAT BEGINNING AROUND MIDDAY AND CONTINUING INTO THIS EVENING. ..THOMPSON/SMITH.. 06/14/2010

sections.title: TX/OK
sections.text: LATEST SURFACE ANALYSIS SHOWS A REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY EXTENDING FROM SOUTHWEST OF LBB INTO SOUTHWEST OK. MEANWHILE...THE PRIMARY SYNOPTIC COLD FRONT WILL MOVE SOUTHWARD ACROSS THE TX PANHANDLE. THE SOUTHERN BOUNDARY IS EXPECTED TO PROVIDE SUFFICIENT LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE AND LIFT FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON. MID LEVEL WINDS OF 30-40 KNOTS WILL PROVIDE SUFFICIENT EFFECTIVE SHEAR FOR SUPERCELL STORMS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL /POTENTIALLY VERY LARGE/ ALONG WITH DAMAGING WINDS. LOW LEVEL WIND FIELDS ARE RATHER WEAK. HOWEVER...PRESENCE OF BOUNDARY AND HIGH CAPE VALUES COMBINED WITH SUPERCELL STRUCTURES MAY RESULT IN A COUPLE OF TORNADOES AS WELL.

sections.title: OH VALLEY
sections.text: STRONG DAYTIME HEATING IS OCCURRING ACROSS PORTIONS OF IL/IND/OH/KY AHEAD OF WEAK REMNANT MCV. THIS AREA WILL LIKELY SEE SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON...BOTH ALONG THE OLD OUTFLOW BOUNDARY AND ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR. VERTICAL SHEAR IS SUFFICIENT FOR ORGANIZED MULTICELL STORMS CAPABLE OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS. POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR UPSCALE MCS EVOLUTION THROUGH THE EVENING WITH AN ENHANCED RISK OF DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.title: CENTRAL APPALACHIANS
sections.text: A SMALL CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS IS CURRENTLY OVER EASTERN KY...MOVING SOUTHEASTWARD AT 25 KT. CONTINUED DESTABILIZATION AHEAD OF THE STORMS MAY LEAD TO A FEW INTENSE CORES THROUGH THE AFTERNOON CAPABLE OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. ..HART/GRAMS.. 06/14/2010

sections.title: TX/OK TO MO/AR
sections.text: REFERENCE SEVERE TSTM WATCH 317 AND ASSOCIATED MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS FOR THE LATEST DETAILS. STRONG/SEVERE TSTMS WILL BE MAINLY FOCUSED ALONG RESIDUAL SURFACE OUTFLOW/EFFECTIVE COLD FRONT FROM THE TX SOUTH PLAINS NORTHEASTWARD INTO OK AND AR/SOUTHERN MO THROUGH THIS EVENING. SEVERE HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREAT ACROSS WEST/NORTHWEST TX INTO SOUTHWEST OK...AND A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO IS POSSIBLE PRIOR TO STORMS BEING UNDERCUT BY THE BOUNDARY. OTHERWISE...CONGEALING STORMS/EVOLVING LINEAR CLUSTERS ACROSS THIS CORRIDOR MAY ALSO POSE A DAMAGING WIND THREAT.

sections.title: OH/TN RIVER VALLEYS
sections.text: AIDED BY A NORTHERN IL MCV AND STRONG DESTABILIZATION /2000-3000 J PER KG MLCAPE/ ACROSS THE OH/TN RIVER VALLEY...TSTM COVERAGE/INTENSITY WILL CONTINUE TO INCREASE IN THE SHORT TERM ACROSS A BROAD PORTION OF THE OH/TN RIVER VALLEY. MODESTLY STRONG/NEARLY UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND PROFILES WILL SUPPORT UPSCALE CONVECTIVE GROWTH/LINEAR CLUSTERS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS/SOME HAIL. VIGOR OF THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD WANE TOWARD/AFTER SUNSET.

sections.title: CENTRAL APPALACHIANS
sections.text: SPATIALLY EXPANDED CATEGORICAL SLIGHT RISK NEAR/IMMEDIATE LEE OF THE APPALACHIANS IN ACCORDANCE WITH SEVERE TSTM WATCH 316. DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE THE PRIMARY CONCERN THROUGH SUNSET WITH MULTICELLS/LINEAR CLUSTERS OCCURRING WITHIN A MODESTLY SHEARED BUT UNSTABLE/VERY MOIST ENVIRONMENT.

sections.title: SOUTHEAST CO/NORTHEAST NM
sections.text: ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT /MAINLY HAIL/ WILL EXIST ACROSS SOUTHEAST CO/NORTHEAST NM THIS AFTERNOON...ALTHOUGH INSTABILITY/INHIBITION INCREASES WITH EASTWARD EXTENT ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS AWAY FROM THE CO/NM HIGHER TERRAIN. FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION...REFERENCE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 941. ..GUYER.. 06/14/2010 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1107 AM CDT MON JUN 14 2010/ A BROAD SURFACE RIDGE IS PRESENT TODAY OVER THE SOUTHEAST STATES...WITH A BAND OF MODERATELY STRONG MID LEVEL FLOW EXTENDING FROM THE SOUTHERN ROCKIES...ACROSS THE CENTRAL PLAINS AND MID MS VALLEY...INTO THE GREAT LAKES REGION. A SURFACE BAROCLINIC ZONE PARALLELS THIS SOUTHERN FRINGE OF STRONGER FLOW...AND WILL LIKELY BE THE MAIN FOCUS FOR STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS TODAY.

sections.title: SRN PLAINS/OZARKS
sections.text: A LINEAR MCS WILL CONTINUE TO BECOME INCREASINGLY ORGANIZED IN WEST TX THIS EVENING. THE MCS IS LOCATED ON THE WRN EDGE OF STRONG INSTABILITY AND JUST TO THE EAST OF A SHORTWAVE TROUGH EVIDENT ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY. OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS IS ESTIMATED MLCAPE VALUES IN THE 2000 TO 3000 J/KG RANGE ACROSS WCNTRL TX. THIS ALONG WITH A STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL JET SHOULD SUSTAIN THE MCS EWD ACROSS NCNTRL TX THIS EVENING. THE MCS IS ALSO LOCATED IN THE RIGHT ENTRANCE REGION OF A 50 TO 60 KT MID-LEVEL JET. THIS FEATURE IS CREATING MODERATE DEEP LAYER SHEAR PROFILES ACROSS WEST TX WHICH ALONG WITH STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL CONTINUE TO BE FAVORABLE FOR LARGE HAIL WITH ROTATING STORMS EMBEDDED IN THE MCS. A TORNADO THREAT MAY ALSO EXIST AS THE LOW-LEVEL JET STRENGTHENS EARLY THIS EVENING. HOWEVER...THE WIND DAMAGE AND HEAVY RAIN THREAT SHOULD BECOME INCREASINGLY DOMINANT AS A LINEAR STRUCTURE ORGANIZES OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT WILL ALSO EXIST SSWWD INTO FAR WEST TX WHERE MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE VERY STEEP. A SECOND LINEAR MCS IS ALSO ONGOING IN ERN OK NEAR THE AXIS OF A SHORTWAVE TROUGH EVIDENT ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY. THE MCS IS LOCATED ON THE NOSE OF A 25 TO 3

sections.title: OH VALLEY
sections.text: A LINEAR MCS IS CURRENTLY ONGOING IN CNTRL AND SRN IND NEAR A EAST-WEST OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ALONG THE NRN EDGE OF MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY. OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS IS ESTIMATING SBCAPE JUST AHEAD OF THE MCS IN THE 3000 TO 4000 J/KG RANGE WHICH SHOULD SUPPORT THE MCS EWD ACROSS SRN OH AND NRN KY THIS EVENING. A WELL-DEFINED RISE/FALL PRESSURE COUPLET IS ASSOCIATED WITH THE MCS SUGGESTING THE BOWING LINE-SEGMENT COULD REMAIN ORGANIZED FOR SEVERAL MORE HOURS. UNIDIRECTIONAL WINDS ALONG AND SOUTH OF THE BOUNDARY WITH A VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER /SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 70S F/ SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND THIS THREAT COULD EXTEND EWD INTO THE CNTRL APPALACHIAN MTNS LATER THIS EVENING.

sections.title: MID-MO VALLEY
sections.text: A CLUSTER OF STRONG THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING ACROSS THE MID-MO VALLEY IN AN AREA OF MODERATE INSTABILITY WITH OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SHOWING MLCAPE VALUES IN THE 1000 TO 1500 J/KG RANGE. THE THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY IS LOCATED IN THE LEFT EXIT REGION OF THE MID-LEVEL JET AND LIFT ASSOCIATED WITH THIS FEATURE APPEARS TO BE SUPPORTING CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT. THE MID-LEVEL JET IS ALSO CREATING STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR PROFILES WHICH ALONG WITH THE INSTABILITY AND STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR HAIL WITH THE MORE INTENSE CORES. STRONG GUSTY WINDS WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE WITH THE CONVECTION REMAINING STRONG FOR A FEW MORE HOURS. ..BROYLES.. 06/15/2010
